visualCharacteristics.purpose: Thin horizontal strip of share-price figures (Teleborsa ticker)
visualCharacteristics.description: Thin 64px white strip with live Terna share data (Ultimo prezzo, Variazione %, Apertura, ...), scrolling marquee.

contentPattern.summary: Thin horizontal scrolling strip of live share-price figures.
contentPattern.structure: either one cell with a link to /widgets/<path>/<name>.html (loads the live widget), or a snapshot table: row 1 = title | timestamp, each further row = label | value (values starting with - or + are flagged negative/positive). Scrolls as a marquee unless reduced motion is preferred
contentPattern.sourceContent: Live stock ticker "Terna - Indici Teleborsa" (third-party live data)

usage: Share price strip below the homepage hero.
reuseGuidance: Use for any short key/value live-figure strip. For boxed figures with deltas and timestamps use widget-live-data.
